name: app/confirm-action
title: ConfirmAction
summary: A destructive action that asks before it acts. A trigger opens a confirmation panel through the Popover API (no script); the panel is a POST form with hidden fields and a required confirm step (a checkbox, or typing a given text), names the danger in words ("Warning: …"), and has Cancel and a destructive submit that names the action.

props.name: id
props.description: A unique id on the page. The panel is `<id>-panel`; the title, description, warning and confirm input are `<id>-title`, `<id>-description`, `<id>-warning` and `<id>-confirm`.

props.name: label
props.description: The trigger's text, naming the action ("Remove member").

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading ("Remove Rudo Chari from Kweli Foods?").

props.name: description
props.description: What happens, in a sentence; the panel's first description.

props.name: warningLabel
props.description: The word that names the danger, for another language.

props.name: fields
props.description: Hidden fields posted with the form (`{ member: "rudo" }`).

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The submit button's text; defaults to `label`.

props.name: confirmText
props.description: Text the person must type to confirm ("DELETE", a listing's name). Without it they tick a checkbox.

props.name: confirmPrompt
props.description: The typed step's label, in place of "Type <confirmText> to confirm".

props.name: acknowledge
props.description: The checkbox's label when there is no `confirmText`.

props.name: variant
props.description: The trigger's look: an outline for an action among others, filled for the one irreversible action on a page.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged last.

behaviour: The trigger is a <button type="button" popovertarget="<id>-panel" aria-haspopup="dialog"> that names the action. It submits nothing.

The panel is <div popover="auto" role="dialog">, labelled by its heading and described by the description and the warning. The Popover API opens it from the trigger and closes it on Escape, a click outside, or Cancel (popovertargetaction="hide"). No script.
The danger is written, not only coloured: the warning reads "<warningLabel> <warning>" ("Warning: This cannot be undone.") with a warning glyph, and the submit button names the action.
The panel is a <form> (POST unless `method` is "get") to `action`, posting its hidden `fields` and the confirm step as `confirm`.

Without `confirmText` the confirm step is a required checkbox (`confirm=yes`) labelled `acknowledge`. With it, a required text box labelled "Type <confirmText> to confirm" (or `confirmPrompt`) whose `pattern` matches exactly that text, regex syntax escaped. The browser blocks the submit until the step is done; the server must check `confirm` as well.
In a browser without the Popover API the panel shows in place under the trigger; it is still the form with the confirm step.

default.description: Removing a team member, confirmed with a checkbox.

props.label: Remove member
props.title: Remove Rudo Chari from Kweli Foods?
props.description: Rudo loses access to this business straight away.

typed.description: Deleting a listing, confirmed by typing its name; filled trigger, small, h3.

props.label: Delete listing
props.title: Delete kweli-foods.co?
props.warning: The listing, its photos and its reviews are deleted.

localised.description: Every word replaced, for another language.

prompt.description: A typed step with its own prompt.

roles: dialog (the panel, named by its heading)
keyboard: Enter or Space on the trigger opens the panel.
Tab moves through the confirm step, Cancel and the submit button.
focus: The Popover API returns focus to the trigger when the panel closes.
aria: The panel has role="dialog", aria-labelledby (its heading) and aria-describedby (the description and the warning).
The confirm step has a visible label.

theming.brandOverlay: None that changes meaning: the danger is the destructive tokens in every brand; the confirm checkbox takes the shell's accent (`--app-accent`, else `--primary`) and focus rings `--ring`.

noJs.without: Everything: the Popover API opens and closes the panel, and the form posts with the browser's own validation of the confirm step.

responsive: The panel is at most 28rem wide and never wider than the viewport less 2rem; its buttons wrap.
contract:
contract
  slot is "confirm-action"
  uses confirm-panel
  uses confirm-warning
  when default shows button "Remove member"
  when default shows strong "Warning:"
  when default shows h2 "Remove Rudo Chari from Kweli Foods?"
  when typed shows h3 "Delete kweli-foods.co?"
  when localised shows strong "Tahadhari:"
end

checks.say: The trigger opens the panel and posts nothing.
The panel is a popover dialog, labelled and described.
Without a description, the warning alone describes it.
The form posts to the action with its hidden fields.
The confirm step is a required checkbox posting confirm=yes.
Cancel closes the panel and posts nothing.
The submit names the action, in the destructive style.
Without confirmLabel the submit repeats the trigger.
The typed step is a required box whose pattern is exactly the text, escaped.
The typed step says what to type.
A typed step has no checkbox.
The filled trigger is the destructive button.
confirmPrompt replaces the typed step's label.

gaps: Focus does not move into the panel when it opens (the Popover API leaves it on the trigger); Tab reaches the panel next, since it follows the trigger in the DOM. A <dialog> opened with showModal() would move it, but needs script.
